name: Adaptive Image Sampling with Pixel Sharing
definition: An adaptive sampling method that divides the image plane into square sample regions, casts rays only from corner pixels to measure complexity, and subdivides regions with high complexity. It handles dependencies between adjacent regions by communicating pixel values rather than replicating ray tracing.
summary: Adaptive Image Sampling with Pixel Sharing is a parallel volume rendering optimization that reduces cost by casting rays only at square region corners and interpolating interiors, managing synchronization for shared pixels.
